title: Two cosmic milestones
hook: Explore the evidence behind a cosmic question.

knows: Light and gravity help astronomers study the universe.
doesNotKnow: The cosmic microwave background was released before the first stars formed. The intervening period is often called the cosmic dark ages because stars had not yet lit the universe.

misconception: A learner may choose: The formation of the first stars
objective: Use the visual model to reason about: Which came first in the standard cosmic timeline?

claims.text: Question, correct answer and explanation: Which came first in the standard cosmic timeline? The release of the cosmic microwave background. The cosmic microwave background was released before the first stars formed. The intervening period is often called the cosmic dark ages because stars had not yet lit the universe.
